facts.business: Mukta Arts Limited is an Indian media and entertainment company engaged in film production, film exhibition through its subsidiary Mukta A2 Cinemas, media education through Whistling Woods International, content monetization on digital platforms, TV serial production, event management, and mobile-based solutions.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to investment in and recoverables from subsidiary Whistling Woods International Limited (WWIL) aggregating to Rs. 19.95 crore and Rs. 64.14 crore respectively, where WWIL's net worth is fully eroded and a land dispute with MFSCDCL remains unresolved despite interim stay; auditors unable to determine possible effects on financial statements.

key_risks: Ongoing land dispute with MFSCDCL regarding Whistling Woods International premises; High Court quashed JV agreement; review petitions pending final hearing
Subsidiary WWIL's net worth fully eroded as at March 31, 2026; going concern dependent on outcome of litigation and holding company support
Investor in Mukta A2 Cinemas failed to honour SHA/SSA commitments leading to termination of agreement
Mukta A2 Multiplex WLL in Bahrain facing decreased revenue due to non-availability of good content from Middle East war situation
MA2 ceased operations at 9 screens across 4 locations due to continued losses
Asian Mukta A2 Cinemas LLP closing loss-making properties
Standalone revenue and profit reduced due to no new film/serial release in FY 2025-26
Film industry footfall recovery remains a long-term challenge despite box office growth being price-led
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with subsidiaries (Whistling Woods International, Mukta A2 Cinemas, Mukta A2 Multiplex WLL, Mukta VN Films, Mukta Creative Ventures, Connect.1), key management personnel (Subhash Ghai, Parvez Farooqui, Rahul Puri, Mukta Ghai, Ashok Ghai, Siraj Farooqui, Sameer Farooqui, Meghna Ghai Puri, Muskaan Ghai), and enterprises under their control (Mukta Arts proprietary concern, Mukta Tele Arts LLP). Includes rendering/receiving services, rent, interest income/expenses, and professional fees. Notable: Rs. 29,126 thousand interest income from WWIL, Rs. 68,787 thousand from MA2 Cinemas, Rs. 10,437 thousand from MA2 Multiplex WLL in FY 2026.
